charlie_cust: Hi team, customer reporting intermittent 500s from the embeddings endpoint. They gave a request_id: b3f7a9d2. Payloads are small, but latency spikes before the failure. Happening for multiple users since ~14:20 UTC.

alice_support: Thanks @charlie_cust — can you paste the raw request_id and a minimal curl repro? Also can you confirm region and model variant?

charlie_cust: request_id=b3f7a9d2, region=us-west-2, model=redwood-open-1.0. curl they used:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"test"}' \n  -v
```

alice_support: Perfect. Can you also grab a debug bundle (headers + request/response) and attach to the support ticket? Steps: include `-v` on curl and save response headers, plus the full request_id in the body. If they can't share tokens, ask them to redact but keep `request_id`.

ben_engineer: I'll go look for the request in logs. Quick heads up: hosted request logs are retained 30 days; trace-level spans stored for 90 days. If this happened >30d ago we may only have partial traces.

ben_engineer: Running internal log search for request_id b3f7a9d2:

```bash
# internal CLI (rb-logs)
rb-logs query "request_id:b3f7a9d2" --env=prod --since=4h --limit=100
```

logbot: Found 3 log fragments for b3f7a9d2 — linking: https://logs.internal.redwood/entries/b3f7a9d2

logbot: ```
2026-03-17T14:20:12.321Z ingress-api-prod INFO request_id=b3f7a9d2 latency_ms=987 status=200 route=/v1/embeddings
2026-03-17T14:20:13.112Z edge-proxy-prod WARN request_id=b3f7a9d2 latency_ms=1432 status=502 upstream=shard-11
2026-03-17T14:20:13.118Z ingress-api-prod ERROR request_id=b3f7a9d2 status=500 error="upstream error: 502"
```

dana_sre: Looks like the ingress returned 200 at first, then edge proxy saw an upstream 502 from a model shard and surfaced a 500 to the client. Can you confirm if the customer saw any retry behavior?

charlie_cust: They said they saw one retry from their SDK and then the client returned 500. No custom retry config.

ben_engineer: Checking shard health around that time: `k8s get pods -n infer | grep shard-11` show OOMKilled? Pulling events...

ben_engineer: Events show repeated OOMKill for shard-11 around 14:19-14:22 UTC. Also see increasing memory pressure on node ip-10-0-2-45. Log snippet: 

```
2026-03-17T14:18:59.912Z shard-11 ERROR oom_killer invoked, pid=3211, rss=84GB
2026-03-17T14:19:00.003Z node-monitor WARN memory_pressure=critical node=ip-10-0-2-45
```

alice_support: So root cause looks like shard OOM -> 502 -> client 500. For customer-facing notes: tell them we observed an upstream model shard OOM at the same time as their request_id, which caused the transient 500. We're investigating why shard experienced memory spike and will apply mitigations.

charlie_cust: Appreciate that. What mitigations do you recommend for customers?

dana_sre: For immediate mitigation: switch to a different model variant (redwood-open-1.0-small) or enable our automatic fallback policy (we can flip on a per-tenant fallback for a few hours). On our side we'll: 1) cordon the affected node, 2) increase memory limit for shard pods in that pool, and 3) add soft-restart/backoff to the model runner to avoid hard OOM.

ben_engineer: I've opened an internal ticket INF-4789 and assigned to eng-runtime to adjust limits and add a metric alert for memory spikes on shard pods.

alice_support: Next steps for support: please request the customer's debug bundle (curl -v output + timestamps + request_id). If they can attach it to ticket #12345 that helps. Also ask if they can try the small model variant to confirm.

charlie_cust: I'll send the instructions to the customer now and ask them to try the small model. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

logbot: Note: retention policy reminder — only raw request logs retained 30 days; if the customer comes back later >30d we may need to rely on trace sampling or ask for repro.

alice_support: Closing loop here — change log: customer notified, eng-runtime triaging INF-4789, offering fallback and variant. Reopen if customer uploads debug bundle and we need deeper trace.
